title: Agribusiness Management, B.S. (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: University Park. Built from the archived 2023-24 bulletin's University Park 'Suggested Academic Plan' table (raw HTML table rows fetched and parsed directly, per-semester Fall/Spring credit subtotals cross-checked against the page's own printed 14/13/16/15/15/15/16.5-17.5/15.5 = 120-121 total -- not WebFetch's summary). Real, verified differences from the 2026 edition: (1) pre-2024 Gen Ed structure -- the 2023 edition predates PSU's Gen Ed Foundations/domain-tag reform, so it uses plain untagged 'General Education Course' slots throughout (no GN/GH/GA/GWS/Exploration/Integrative-Studies labels the 2024-2026 editions carry), and an explicit Communications requirement 'CAS 100, CAS 100A, CAS 100B, or CAS 100C' in year 2 (modeled here as CAS 100A/100B/100C -- the catalog's course data has no bare 'CAS 100' entry, only the lettered sections) instead of the later editions' generic GWS-tagged slot; (2) ENGL 202D is the sole writing requirement -- ENGL 202C does not appear anywhere on this archived page (Suggested Plan or Program Requirements tab) as an alternate, unlike 2024-2026's 'ENGL 202D (or 202C)'; (3) year 1 is 6cr lighter (14+13=27) than 2024-2026's year 1 (17+16=33) because of the missing domain-tag Gen Ed/Integrative-Studies slots -- byte-for-byte the same core AGBM/business course sequence otherwise; (4) the 4 Supporting Course (specialty-area) slots land in Fall+Spring of year 2 and Fall+Spring of year 4 here, vs the 2026 edition's year2-Fall/year2-Spring/year3-Spring/year4-Fall spread -- both total the same 12cr footnote requirement, just resequenced across the flowchart. Confirmed unchanged from 2026: all AGBM-prefixed courses and their positions relative to each other, ACCTG 211, SCM 200/STAT 200, ECON 104, MKTG 301, FIN 301, MGMT 301, IST 110/MIS 204/250/SRA 111, SCM 301, BA 243/BLAW 243/BA 342/BLAW 341 (already a simple 4-way OR by this edition, capped at 3-4cr -- see AGBM-2022.json's notes for the older 2022 wording that still allowed a BA 342 + BLAW 341 combined path), AGBM 400-level electives, and the 12cr Supporting Course pool. Same real hidden-prereq gap as 2026 (ACCTG 211, STAT 200, and SCM 200 all resolve to needing MATH 21 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 3 in this app's shared, year-independent course catalog): added the identical MATH 3 (Semester 1) / MATH 4 (Semester 2) / MATH 21 (Semester 3) gap-fix chain, adding the same 9cr beyond the bulletin's own stated total, documented rather than silently absorbed. Fits within the existing max_credits_per_semester (17); build_full_plan simulates real terms rather than rigidly binding each semester object's own item sum to that cap, same as the 2026 edition already relies on.
